public_family_candidate: Schmitt-trigger/hysteresis state machine with separate switch thresholds and a retained-state deadband

fatal_gates.F1: immutable terminal evidence/history is preserved; hysteresis changes only current selection qualification
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/protected-primary/external hosted controller, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 utility comparisons use only unique independently read-back same-scope terminal identities for A and B
G2 define d = utility(B)-utility(A); while current=A, remain A for d<+2.0 and switch to B only when d>=+2.0
G3 while current=B, remain B for d>-2.0 and switch to A only when d<=-2.0
G4 values inside the deadband (-2.0,+2.0) retain the previous assignment rather than selecting by sign alone
G5 current assignment and the evidence identities supporting the last threshold crossing are durably recorded before the next comparison
G6 duplicate or stale terminal replay cannot produce another switch, score update, or credit
G7 a comparison whose scope key differs from the current assignment evidence is incomparable and cannot cross either threshold until same-scope re-evaluation
G8 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and leaves the prior durable assignment authoritative
G9 switch credit is zero until the new selected assignment terminal/readback identity is durable; repeated readback of the same terminal identity adds no credit
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier and zero residual richer-mode/user execution, zero finite quota, zero incremental monetary cost

candidate_patterns.pattern: switch to whichever assignment has the positive sign of d on every comparison
never switch once an assignment is selected
stateful two-threshold hysteresis with retained-state deadband, same-scope evidence, durable switch identity, and stale/duplicate rejection
delegate threshold state and score comparison to an external hosted controller

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not change thresholds, trace, scope control, guards, or candidate patterns after public source read.
credit_rule: Precommit and threshold crossing alone earn zero credit. At most one new leaf credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native hysteresis reduction passes the fixed trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read this precommit back, checkpoint it as pending with zero credit, then audit public Schmitt-trigger/hysteresis sources before any other family selection; bind only source-supported hysteresis semantics, execute HS-A..HS-D against the fixed trace, and seal/read back terminal evidence before credit.
